_: The village round each land's lot (tools/realm/village.py; the owner's Kingdom Base Builder Kit, Oct 2026: its 48 building pictures, one set to a land). Each picture as [x, y, w]: where it stands on the land's landscape (px: the middle of its foot, the kit's anchor) and how wide it's drawn (px). The castle and great hall beyond the lot, the towers at its far sides, the cottages, forge and storage before it, a land's two extras (the desert's well and palms, the forest's moonstone and glowing tree) at its near corners; the docks and ships left out, as the kit says (no shore for them). spots is every land's; a land's own spots move or drop (null) one of them there. Keep every foot clear of the build zone round the lot (sceneries.py: the lot's diamond and a little): the script says when one isn't.
